title: Elucidation of the Molecular Interaction Network Underlying Full-Length FUS Conformational Transitions and Its Phase Separation Using Atomistic Simulations.
authors: Weng, Shuo-Lin; Mohanty, Priyesh; Mittal, Jeetain
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子分子动力学模拟系统解析全长FUS蛋白中IDR主导的分子互作网络及其相分离机制，直接命中无序蛋白、PPI互作机制与物理模拟方法三轴，且深入探讨折叠域稳定性与IDR互作的耦合，对相分离中PPI机制建模极具参考价值。
abstract: Fused in Sarcoma (FUS) is a multidomain nucleic acid binding protein which orchestrates cellular functions such as gene expression, transcription, and DNA repair through liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). While crucial to understanding cellular processes, an atomic-level view of the molecular-level interactions associated with full-length (FL) FUS LLPS remains challenging due to its low solubility in vitro. Here, using all-atom (AA) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we examined the conformational dynamics and interactions of FL FUS in both dilute and condensed phases. Comparing two modern force fields (FFs) horizontal line Amber ff03ws and ff99SBws-STQ, we found that monomer simulation ensembles generated by both FFs exhibited qualitatively similar intramolecular interaction profiles dominated by intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs). While the two folded domains minimally participated in intramolecular interactions, their stabilities significantly influenced the chain dimension and led to discrepancies compared to experimental data for both FFs. We observed that the Amber ff99SBws-STQ coupled with parameters adopted from the Zinc Amber force field (ZAFF) maintained stable folded domains and improved estimates of the chain dimensions. Finally, a microsecond-time scale simulation of FL FUS condensate revealed an extensive network of electrostatic interactions which are strongly correlated with those that modulate the dilute phase conformations. Overall, insights from our AAMD simulations illuminate the interplay between folded domain stability and IDR interactions in modulating protein conformation and phase separation.
abstract_zh: 肉瘤融合蛋白（FUS）是一种多结构域核酸结合蛋白，通过液-液相分离（LLPS）调控基因表达、转录及DNA修复等细胞功能。尽管对理解细胞过程至关重要，但由于全长（FL）FUS在体外的低溶解度，对其LLPS相关的分子层面相互作用的原子级视角仍具挑战性。在此，我们利用全原子（AA）分子动力学（MD）模拟，研究了FL FUS在稀相和凝聚相中的构象动力学及相互作用。通过比较两种现代力场（FFs）——Amber ff03ws和ff99SBws-STQ，我们发现两种力场生成的单体模拟集合在定性上表现出相似的分子内相互作用特征，主要由内在无序区域（IDRs）主导。尽管两个折叠结构域在分子内相互作用中参与度最低，但其稳定性显著影响链尺寸，并导致与实验数据相比两种力场均存在差异。我们观察到，采用Zinc Amber力场（ZAFF）参数的Amber ff99SBws-STQ力场保持了折叠结构域的稳定性，并改善了链尺寸的估计。最后，微秒时间尺度的FL FUS凝聚体模拟揭示了一个广泛的静电相互作用网络，这些相互作用与调节稀相构象的相互作用密切相关。总体而言，我们的AAMD模拟洞察阐明了折叠结构域稳定性与IDR相互作用在调节蛋白质构象和相分离中的相互作用。
